column1: # PSR-E343 Voice List (Panel 1-205 incl. 18 drum kits, XGlite 206-550), extracted from the official Yamaha Owner's Manual psre343_en_om_b0.pdf, pages 48-52.
# Program is 1-based exactly as printed (send PC = program - 1). Columns after the 4th are informational; the app reads name, MSB, LSB, program.
# DUAL voices (153-179) have no Bank/Program in the manual ("–"; they layer two voices) and cannot be selected over MIDI: listed as comments only.
